name: separator-07
description: Order receipt with dashed separators setting apart line items, fees and total.

files.content:
import { Separator } from "@workspace/ui/components/separator" const lines = [ { label: "Portfolio Simple template", amount: 4.5 }, { label: "Icons Pack", amount: 3.75 }, { label: "Logos Pack", amount: 2.25 }, ] const dashed = "bg-transparent bg-[repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,var(--border)_0_6px,transparent_6px_12px)]" export default function DashedReceiptSeparator() { const subtotal = lines.reduce((sum, line) => sum + line.amount, 0) const tax = subtotal * 0.08 return (
DESIGNALI
Order #2041 · designali.com
{lines.map((line) => (
{line.label} {line.amount.toFixed(2)}
))}
Tax {tax.toFixed(2)}
Total {(subtotal + tax).toFixed(2)}
) }
